info.title: Envelopen API
info.description: Every operation of the Envelopen admin app. Send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer evk_...`. Lists use cursor pagination. POST requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header. A browser session picks its workspace with the `X-Envelopen-Workspace` header.

bearerAuth.description: An Envelopen API key. The browser app uses its session cookie instead. Send `Idempotency-Key` on POST to make retries safe.

sourceUrl.description: The link to the source code of this deployment.

workersPlan.description: The Workers plan of the Cloudflare account, as the owner set it. On `free`, welcome steps wait after 70% of the daily D1 writes. On `paid`, they do not.

s3.description: The S3-compatible copy destination. The secret is never returned.

nextRunAt.description: The next daily backup, when enabled.

readBudget.description: D1 rows that backups may read per UTC day.

passphraseDerivation.description: The latest passphrase key derivation. It runs in the background for a few seconds after the passphrase is set. The passphrase is in use when it is ready.

restore.description: Set after a restore until the owner confirms the age of the backup. Campaign sends wait until then.

url.description: The download path. It works without a session until it expires.

prefix.description: The start of the key, to recognize it.
The start of the key, to recognize it.

fields.description: Custom field values by field key. A choice field gives the option id, and a multiple choice field a JSON array of option ids, for example `[12,15]`. `fields.list` has the labels.

post.description: Starts the derivation of the backup key from the passphrase, and returns at once. The status shows when the key is ready. Envelopen stores only the public part. post.summary: Create or update a contact by email
post.description: Finds the contact by its email address (trimmed and lowercased) and creates it when it does not exist. Adds the tags (created when missing) and subscribes to the lists. Never reverses an unsubscribe or a suppression. An API key cannot raise a consent basis of `unknown`: the call then succeeds and returns the warning `consent_upgrade_blocked`. Use this to sync enrollments from another app.

consentBasis.description: Basis for a new contact (default `unknown`), or a change for an existing one.

tags.description: Tag names. Missing tags are created.

fields.description: Custom field values by key (lowercase letters, digits, underscores). Missing fields are created as text fields. Null clears a value. A choice field takes an option id or an option label (labels match without regard to case). A multiple choice field takes a list of option ids or labels, or one text with labels separated by commas. An unknown option, or an option of another field, fails with `invalid_input`. Reads return option ids: see `fields.list`.

startWelcome.description: Start the welcome series of each list in `listIds` that has one turned on. A contact who started a series earlier does not get it again.

delete.description: Deletes the contact, its tags, memberships, field values, and consent history. When the contact had unsubscribed, a suppression (reason `erased`) keeps the address from coming back through an import or an upsert. Unsubscribing keeps the contact, so use `contacts.update` with `unsubscribe` for that. When the contact's consent basis was `unknown`, an API key that adds the address again gets the basis `unknown` too.
